messages:
Ava (People Ops): Quick heads-up: running a short "annual attest + privacy blitz" from Mon 06/02 to Fri 06/13. Two must-dos for everyone: 1) complete the 10-min privacy refresher (link); 2) submit the attestation form (link).

Ava (People Ops): If you own controls, also upload any updated evidence to /Evidence/Attest-2026. Use filename pattern: team_controlid_shortdesc_YYYYMMDD.pdf (example: eng_AC-4_session-logs_20240603.pdf). Update the tracker after uploading.

Noah (Security): For exports include a 1-paragraph README with collection window, retention, and who can access. If pulling logs from GCP: 
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type=gke_cluster' --project=redwood-prod --format=json > gke-logs-20240603.json
```
Place README next to the JSON.

Cam (Eng): Will upload inference request logs and the README by Wed. Quick Q: should we include hashes for files?

Ava (People Ops): Good idea but optional; if you add a checksum, put it in the README.

LegalBot: Reminder: any artifact with customer PII must have a redaction rationale doc and a signed redaction confirmation in the same folder. Open an "evidence-exception" ticket for reviewer help.

Ava (People Ops): Office hours this week: Tue 10:00-11:00 and Thu 16:00-17:00 in #help for upload/name checks. If you need a 48h extension for legal review, open an exception ticket and tag @Noah.

Cam (Eng): Thanks  will bring filenames to office hours.

Ava (People Ops): TL;DR: privacy refresher + attestation + upload if you own controls. Deadline Fri 06/13 EOD. Ping me with blockers. :sparkles:
